## Details

<a id="landscape_map"></a>
### [`landscape_map`](../../../../src/data/map.asm#L6) `$3800-$3FFF`

*data*

Landscape map: 8 rows of 256 character codes, one page each. Row 0 is screen row 12. An airfield is $16 $17 $16 $17, destroyed $6f $70 $6f $70. The six airfields are in row 0 at the map columns 4, 40, 84, 136, 172 and 200.

- **Read by:** [`radar_plot_all`](../radar/radar_52f0.md#radar_plot_all), [`landing_check`](../player/landing.md#landing_check), [`airfield_bomb_hit`](../landscape/airfield_bombing.md#airfield_bomb_hit), [`airfields_restore`](../landscape/airfield_bombing_5fd0.md#airfields_restore)
- **Written by:** [`airfield_bomb_hit`](../landscape/airfield_bombing.md#airfield_bomb_hit), [`airfields_restore`](../landscape/airfield_bombing_5fd0.md#airfields_restore)
- **Referred to by:** [`landscape_set_pointers`](../landscape/scroll_509f.md#landscape_set_pointers)
